description: Inspector actively scans the three most recent deployable (git- tagged) images in each ECR repository

matrix_rows.gap: ECR images, by coverage status, not by a scan date against a declared interval; Inspector rescans on new advisories rather than on a clock. Coverage also lapses: Inspector stops scanning an image 14 days after its push unless it is in use, and the images run only during sessions, so between sessions every deployable image goes INACTIVE (SCAN_ELIGIBILITY_EXPIRED). Red since 2026-10-16, a recorded finding (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-19). The analytics image in Artifact Registry is scanned by Container Scanning, not read here.
Inspector's coverage of recent images is checked; GuardDuty's publishing and the build's audits are judged by their own checks. A feed falling silent is not detected per feed.
